question: Who has been appointed as the first woman Vice Chancellor of the Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU) on July 2025?
solution: The correct answer is __**Prof. Uma Kanjilal**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Prof. Uma Kanjilal** has been appointed as the **first woman Vice Chancellor** of the Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU). • Her appointment marks a significant milestone in the history of IGNOU, which is one of the largest open universities in the world. • The decision to appoint her was announced on **July 2025**, highlighting the increasing representation of women in leadership roles in the education sector. • Prof. Uma Kanjilal has been associated with IGNOU for many years and has contributed significantly to the university's academic and administrative growth. • She is known for her work in promoting **online education and digital learning platforms**, which aligns with IGNOU's mission of providing accessible education.
